Warrior Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The symbol on the chest of the male version is known as the Celtic Wheel of Being.
* The individual armor components are very similar in structure to components from previously released armor sets.

Mesmer Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Mesmer Krytan armor art does not have headgear, but the Mesmer Costume Mask are available from the same armorer in Factions. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page. In Prophecies, the Animal, Imposing and Sleek masks are also available, from collectors.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor.

{{:Mesmer Krytan armor/Collector}}

Elementalist Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also available in the Factions campaign.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor.

{{:Elementalist Krytan armor/Collector}}



*The female chest piece has a clipping error with guild capes
*This is one of the armor sets with odd dying behavior, which is more noticeable in the the female version. Adding two or more dyes will dye the armor in a counterintuitive way.
*Elementalist Elite Stormforged Prestige armor uses the same mesh as this armor.
*Elementalist Thaumaturgic Robes uses the same mesh as this armor.

In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to craft armor for players, the following quests must be completed as well:
*Defend the Temple of War
*Restore the Temple of War
*If he dies, your team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. He will not be threatened by new spawns after completion of Defend the Temple of War, however nearby mobs could be accidentally lured towards him.
*This NPC has a miniature version.
